paragraphs.text: The Wild Woods is a vast forest in North Aerona on Dominaria . This forest lies east of the Whispering Woods . Unlike its neighbor, it is not haunted by strange whispers and is regularly used by cattle and villagers alike.
On the border between the Wild Woods and the Whispering Woods, once laid the village of White Ridge , home to Greensleeves . Eats of the Wild Woods lies Wrenna .
